records.text: New signup alert -- *Bright Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, created a first project on day 0 [email:8418a937] but has sent no invites, filed no tickets, and never replied to the welcome email — no signal of ongoing activity. Single-user Starter accounts that go quiet after initial setup rarely self-activate in 8 days.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Nice work getting Bright Media's first project created last week — that's the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside it, so it's a good base to build on.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk you through getting your team in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I can also answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
